name: VenusBlood DarkChronicle Episode:3 Ryuu Shoujo wa Ningyou ni Otsu
original_name: VenusBlood DarkChronicle Episode:3　竜少女は人形に堕つ
source:
A close-up of VenusBlood GAIA, which gained popularity as a demon-spawning tentacle SLG, and its chaos route!

This is the story of after the ambitions of the Grand Duke Theohrad have come to fruition and the world has become a dystopia, a gigantic testing ground for the Grand Duke's ambitions.
Estella, the dragon empress who was defeated by the Grand Duke, regains her ego and dignity after an intense remodeling surgery, and once again rebels against him.
Her name is the "Boosted Terrier!
In order to protect the old race that is being eliminated and to recover Sleeping Beauty, the only hope, the mechanized dragon girl challenges a lonely battle.

translation:
作为恶魔触手SLG而广受欢迎的《维纳斯之血盖亚》及其混沌路线的特写！

这是大公塞奥拉德的野心实现后的故事，世界变成了反乌托邦，成为大公野心的巨大试验场。
被大公打败的龙后艾丝黛拉，在一次激烈的重塑手术后，重新找回了自我和尊严，并再次反抗大公。
她的名字是“增强梗犬！
为了保护正在被淘汰的旧种族，为了找回唯一的希望睡美人，机械化龙女发起了一场孤独的战斗。”
